title: be.session.ended.v1
description: A browser session ended (logout, idle or absolute timeout, a password change ended the account's other sessions). The record ID is the session digest; the stream be.session.ended has one partition and the edge reads it by position through SessionService/Ended (be-protocol P8.28). Every identity member writes the same event.

session_digest.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the session cookie's value
